thread:
maria: Planning a small config-only push in the midnight quiet window (00:30 UTC). Changes: lower per-tenant rate cap, tighten request timeout, smaller batch for geo-heavy routes. Keeping it canary first at 5%.
chen: Can you paste the exact params? want to check kvcache TTL impact.
maria: sure — config snippet below:
```yaml
routing: 
  geo_routes: 
    - region: eu-west
      batch_size: 8
      timeout_ms: 7000
limits:
  per_tenant_rps: 5
  global_concurrency: 2100
cache:
  kv_ttl_s: 30
```
sam: 5 rps per tenant seems tight for a few customers, but ok for canary. if we see queued latency we should fallback.
lina: adding a fallback plan: if 95th latency > 1200ms for 5m, auto-unwind to previous routing weights and batch_size=16. ops-oncall please ack.
ops-oncall: acked. i'll watch infra dashboards and paging thresholds. set alert for queue depth > 200.
deploy-bot: [deploy] config-only canary start — id=cfg-2026-4940001111 — target=5% of traffic — applied to subset eu-west/low-traffic nodes.
chen: what about model pinning? we had a mismatch last week where small batch + new kernel caused perf weirdness.
maria: not changing model binary. pinning model to v2.3.1 for the rollout (`model_pin: v2.3.1`).
sam: good. also let's set `grace_window: 10m` so we don't flip too quickly.
maria: done. grace_window=10m in rollout. docs note and release notes updated.
deploy-bot: [deploy] canary live — monitoring metrics (latency, error-rate, queue-depth). will report at +5m and +15m.
ops-oncall: seeing slight kv cache churn on a couple nodes, TTL=30s looks ok so far.
chen: if we see KV pressure we should try `kv_ttl_s: 15` as a quick followup to reduce cache size, but that raises miss rate — only if mem pressure shows.
maria: agreed. conservative first run. keep rollback command handy: `redwoodctl config pin --set config_id=cfg-previous --force`
lina: standby for rollback steps. i have the runbook open.
deploy-bot: [deploy] +15m: metrics OK on canary (p95 latency stable, error-rate flat). recommending expand to 25% in 20m.
maria: expanding to 25% now, staging nodes only, still geo-scoped.
ops-oncall: monitoring. will escalate if queue > 300 or error-rate > 0.5%.
sam: thumbs up from product — sounds safe.
maria: thanks all. if anything odd, call the rollback. otherwise i'll finalize release notes in the morning. :thumbsup:
